# Bloom's revised taxonomy

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:scaleBloomRevised`](gmeow-scaleBloomRevised.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/scaleBloomRevised>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/cognition`](../../slices/cognition.md)
- **Box roles:** [ABox role](../boxes/abox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An alternate knowledge-depth framework — Anderson & Krathwohl's revised Bloom's taxonomy (remember ≺ understand ≺ apply ≺ analyze ≺ evaluate ≺ create). Reused as a [`gmeow:ProficiencyScale`](../classes/gmeow-ProficiencyScale.md); its correspondence to the native [`gmeow:KnowledgeLevel`](../classes/gmeow-KnowledgeLevel.md) axis is recorded (softly) in the alignment ledger, not axiomatised.
